notes.title: 6.17BUGFIX
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug that the protagonist would get stuck in the special corner of the crawling zombie
2. Added the number of bullets obtained from the scene
3. Fixed the issue of continuous e-climbing causing ghosting
4. Fixed the issue that remote monsters would interrupt the protagonist's climbing
5. Reduce the attack frequency of mutant insects
6. Fixed the issue that the rocket launcher would attack friendly forces
7. Fixed the issue of death during cg playback
8. Fix the issue of getting stuck in the first level due to closing the door without obtaining the key
